description:
This is a long term contract opportunity.  This candidate must have Angular JS experience.
 

UI .Net Developer
Portland, OR (Remote)
Long term Contract

Looking for GC/USC who can work on our W2 Contract or 1099

 
This is a remote position, but can require travel to client site as needed. It would be best if they live in the Portland, OR area or at least the West Coast.
 

Required Experience

    A BCA/B.Sc/MSC/MCA/B.Tech with major course work in data processing, computer science, or a related field is generally preferred.
    7+ years of .Net coding experience.
    5+ years of hands-on C# .Net.
    Coding experience with .Net 2.0, 4.0 and 4.5 frameworks.
    Experience with AngularJS or other JS frameworks. 
    Experience with CSS 3.0, HTML 5.0 and jQuery.
    Design and develop Restful web services and enhance existing web services with web API.
    Writing automated unit test and integration tests using nUnit and mocking.
    Good knowledge of software design principles – OOD, TDD, and GoF Patterns – including experience with software development methodologies (e.g Agile).
    Experience with lifecycle development and architecture of enterprise level applications with relational or XML based storage solutions.
    Ability to analyze problems and develop solutions; to code, test, and debug computer programs; and to determine software problems.
    Excellent organization skills and the ability to achieve results within tight deadlines.
    Excellent knowledge of customer focused IT delivery methods is required.
    Excellent writing skills, with ability to express strategy, technical knowledge, processes in easily understood presentation.

 

Preferred Experience:

    Experience in developing and deploying application using Windows Azure
    JS testing with Jasmine
    OWIN/Katana
    Experience working with remote teams.

·         Oracle database and/or applications integration experience. 


Strong experience on AngularJS or other JS frameworks
